test_title: PYST 9: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the given words in the order in which they appear in an English dictionary.

i. Monkey

ii. Money

iii. Monotony

iv. Monarch

v. Monster
solution:
The arrangement of the given words in an English dictionary order is as follows :-

__
 
• The first three letters are common to each word: M, O, N.
 
• So, we will compare the words from the fourth letter.

iv. Mon**arch**__

ii. Mon__**ey**__

i. Mon__**key**__

iii. Mon__**otony**__

v. Mon**__ster__**

Hence, the correct answer is **"iv, ii, i, iii, v".**
